prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, reporting right shoulder pain and restricted overhead motion. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported symptoms. Over the course of thirteen visits, care consisted of physical therapy, a home exercise program, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to self-management. Nearly all of the documented findings are based on the patient's own descriptions of pain and limitation. Shoulder imaging was unremarkable, and orthopedic provocation tests performed during the examinations were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the shoulder. Certain billing entries for two services recorded on the same date are currently under review for accuracy and are not reflected in the clinical findings above.
